Package neqsim.thermo.phase

Class DebyeHuckelDerivativeState

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.phase.DebyeHuckelDerivativeState
final class DebyeHuckelDerivativeState extends Object
Immutable derivative state for the extended Debye-Huckel Helmholtz contribution used by PhaseElectrolyteCPAMM.

All derivatives are generated from the same scalar expression at fixed total volume, temperature and component amounts. Internal volume derivatives use cubic metres; callers convert to NeqSim's pressure-scaled volume coordinate at the phase boundary.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa
